profile.headline: Software Engineer @Liberty Mutual
profile.summary: Over the past five years, I have worked in client-facing roles such as a recruiter, sales person, and financial account manager. I learned to have patience, keep calm under pressure, and manage a large volume of clients. Reflecting on my work experiences, I discovered more about my true self and what truly drives me. This realization led me to pursue a career in the tech industry. From my first "Hello World" to developing full-stack applications, the process of debugging and comprehending the inner workings of my code has always exhilarated me. As a software engineer, I am confident in my ability to thrive in any setting due to my varied experience across multiple industries and teams. I am eager to utilize my skills to accomplish my objectives and bring valuable contributions to your organization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Portsmouth, New Hampshire, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
-Updated and tested Node packages for the Injured Worker Portal, SafetyNet and GRS Portal
-Implemented testing frameworks for both the Injured Worker Portal and SafetyNet Application, improving overall testing efficiency by 60% and allowed for quicker deployment cycles that benefited over 5,000 active users
-Utilized Datadog with AWS to deploy and managed 4+ cloud applications, cross-referenced code changes with performance metrics to ensure stability for all applications
-Participated in Agile sprints and retrospectives, which applied a culture of continuous improvement; the new approach led to the successful changes of 3+ products within a single quarter, enhancing overall team productivity
-Competed in the TechStart Hackathon, collaborating with a team of 6 engineers to develop an app designed to connect aspiring engineers for mutual learning and career advancement
-Developed a strong understanding of Agile methodologies and actively participated in Scrum meetings, contributing to effective project management and collaboration efforts
-Shadowed Engineers to know the ins and outs of 4+ applications
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Angular · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Front-End Development · AngularJS · User Experience Design (UED) · Agile Software Development · Node.js · Agile Testing · TypeScript
